clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: MS patients exhibit significant deviations in subcortical volumes relative to a large normative model; integrating SynthSeg-based segmentation with normative modeling may improve characterization of MS progression.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Using T1-weighted and FLAIR MRI segmented with SynthSeg+ and SynthSeg-WMH, subcortical morphometric deviations were identified in 326 MS patients when compared to a reference normative model trained on 37,407 healthy individuals, suggesting potential for refined longitudinal progression modeling.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Leverages DL-based segmentation (SynthSeg+, SynthSeg-WMH) to enable robust subcortical volume estimation in presence of WML and applies normative modeling for patient-specific deviation quantification.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Details on normative model algorithm, predictors, dataset composition, quality control, and site/scanner handling were not available in the accessible text, limiting assessment of robustness and generalizability.
